# Ubiquiti Developer Documentation

> Official API documentation for Ubiquiti's developer platform. Browse API references, guides, and OpenAPI specifications for Site Manager, Network, and Protect services.

Authentication: All APIs use API Key authentication via the `X-API-KEY` header. Generate keys at unifi.ui.com. Site Manager API base URL: `https://api.ui.com`. Network and Protect APIs run locally on each UniFi host and are accessed through the Site Manager Cloud Connector or directly on-site.

## API Services
- [Network API v11.0.97](https://developer.ui.com/network/v11.0.97/gettingstarted): Network API documentation
- [Protect API v7.3.74](https://developer.ui.com/protect/v7.3.74/gettingstarted): Protect API documentation
- [Mobility API v1.0.0](https://developer.ui.com/mobility/v1.0.0/getting-started): Mobility API documentation
- [InnerSpace API v1.3.23](https://developer.ui.com/innerspace/v1.3.23/gettingstarted): InnerSpace API documentation
- [Site Manager API v1.0.0](https://developer.ui.com/site-manager/v1.0.0/gettingstarted): Site Manager API documentation
- [Carrier Fabric API v1.0.0](https://developer.ui.com/carrier-fabric/v1.0.0/getting-started): Carrier Fabric API documentation

## OpenAPI Specifications
- [Network OpenAPI Spec](https://developer.ui.com/network/v11.0.97/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification
- [Network Postman Collection](https://developer.ui.com/network/v11.0.97/postman-collection.json): Postman collection for import
- [Protect OpenAPI Spec](https://developer.ui.com/protect/v7.3.74/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification
- [Protect Postman Collection](https://developer.ui.com/protect/v7.3.74/postman-collection.json): Postman collection for import
- [Mobility OpenAPI Spec](https://developer.ui.com/mobility/v1.0.0/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification
- [Mobility Postman Collection](https://developer.ui.com/mobility/v1.0.0/postman-collection.json): Postman collection for import
- [InnerSpace OpenAPI Spec](https://developer.ui.com/innerspace/v1.3.23/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification
- [InnerSpace Postman Collection](https://developer.ui.com/innerspace/v1.3.23/postman-collection.json): Postman collection for import
- [Site Manager OpenAPI Spec](https://developer.ui.com/site-manager/v1.0.0/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification
- [Site Manager Postman Collection](https://developer.ui.com/site-manager/v1.0.0/postman-collection.json): Postman collection for import
- [Carrier Fabric OpenAPI Spec](https://developer.ui.com/carrier-fabric/v1.0.0/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification
- [Carrier Fabric Postman Collection](https://developer.ui.com/carrier-fabric/v1.0.0/postman-collection.json): Postman collection for import

- `POST /v1/liveviews` - [Create live view](https://developer.ui.com/protect/v7.3.74/post-v1liveviews)

*WebSocket updates*
